purpose: Guarantee that both private managers individually experience every canonical Shared Showdown gameplay screen from shared entry through terminal completion. Role authority may differ, but neither role may silently skip a gameplay screen.

witnessSemantics.fullScreen: The manager's own device visibly renders the complete canonical gameplay surface for that stage, including the authoritative outcome or stage state, not merely a toast, badge, background refresh, summary line or the other manager's screenshot.
witnessSemantics.individualWitness: Each role has its own local witness. One manager seeing a screen never satisfies the other manager's witness.
witnessSemantics.orderedExperience: A device that reconnects, reloads or arrives after provider authority advanced must locally replay any missed canonical screens in journey order before it may proceed beyond them.
witnessSemantics.roleAuthority: A host/coordinator may own a mutation while the peer observes the same full screen with waiting/read-only controls. Different controls are allowed; different gameplay-screen participation is not.
witnessSemantics.persistence: Witness tracking must never mutate the three canonical gameplay localStorage keys merely to prove presentation. Provider-authoritative acknowledgements may be added when a future stage needs a global both-role progression gate.

canonicalJourneyStages.screenRequirement: Both managers individually see the private pairing/session entry state and exact ACTIVE transition before Shared Setup gameplay begins.
Both managers individually enter the Shared Showdown experience bound to the same rivalry/save identities.
Both managers individually see the complete League Wheel screen and authoritative league reveal before their local experience proceeds to Club Packs.
Both managers individually see the complete Club Pack screen and both authoritative club reveals before their local experience proceeds.
Both managers individually see the complete shared season-length choice/locked-result screen, including the peer's authoritative committed value.
Both managers individually see the complete final Shared Setup confirmation screen and their own role-specific confirmation state.
Both managers individually see the complete career-start acknowledgement screen for the same locked clubs and season plan.
Both managers individually experience every canonical Transfer Challenge screen and phase, including timer/guess/signing/completion surfaces; action ownership may differ.
Both managers individually see the full results-entry and review flow; each manager owns only permitted inputs but neither skips the canonical screens.
Both managers individually see the reconciled season review/commit screen and its committed outcome.
Both managers individually see the complete canonical score/winner result screen computed from authoritative season results.
Both managers individually see the same canonical history, manager-record and trophy-attribution gameplay surfaces for the committed season.
Both managers individually see each season transition/advance screen exactly once and retain the fixed clubs across the selected plan.
After reconnect/reload/fresh-session re-entry, the affected device replays or resumes the complete canonical current/missed gameplay screen sequence rather than jumping ahead.
When contention changes authoritative state, both managers' next canonical gameplay screen reflects the same accepted state; conflict handling must not silently skip a normal stage for either role.
Both managers individually see the canonical reconciliation/preview state relevant to the shared journey; destructive Apply remains separately role/transaction-authorized.
Both managers individually see the complete final reconciliation screen with the same final winner/history state.
Both managers individually see the complete terminal completed/closed gameplay screen before the journey becomes non-resurrectable.
Physical acceptance must prove the two devices independently traversed the canonical full-screen sequence rather than inferring one role's UI from the other.
Stable release acceptance must retain the dual-full-screen invariant across the entire deployed journey with no open screen-skipping regression.

implementationGate.mdpRule: A user-facing capability cannot complete MDP implementation, automated-test, regression-retest or product-integration stages unless both managers individually experience every canonical gameplay screen for that capability and the screens satisfy this dual-full-screen contract.
implementationGate.ssjrRule: This contract does not change SSJR weights or grant SSJR credit. It strengthens the product behavior required by the owner's later instruction and must be reflected in applicable production evidence.
implementationGate.currentR6Rule: League Wheel, Club Packs, season length and setup confirmation must preserve per-device ordered witness behavior for both roles; a late/reloaded peer must not skip committed setup screens.
